title: Flowers Bloom and Grow
summary: A celebration of flowers blooming through the seasons. Initial blends create rhythm while imagery captures the beauty of growth and change.

pages.scene: A field of wildflowers just beginning to bloom, fresh and tender
Purple, yellow, and pink flowers basking in sunlight
Green stems stretching upward, reaching toward the sky

pages.text: Frost will come and stop them.
pages.scene: Same flowers now wilting, touched by frost, colors fading

pages.text: But sleep will bring them back.
pages.scene: Flowers dormant beneath snow, quiet and resting

pages.text: The clock goes round and round.

pages.scene: Rainbow light refracting through the garden
Full circle: spring blooms return, vibrant and radiant

metadata.aesthetic_focus: Seasonal cycles, growth and renewal, natural light
